collisionCountReconciliation.initialS380HarnessCause: The first harness draft inserted an isolated collar-point POM without running mapPoloDimensionCallouts, so its candidate did not have the live callout's dimension references/layout state.
collisionCountReconciliation.correctedHarness: Use the exact current live diagnostic callout when present; otherwise map the isolated same-revision source POM through mapPoloDimensionCallouts before comparing the unchanged baseline renderer.
collisionCountReconciliation.reconciliation: The same 17 option values, source revision, mapped callout and browser SVG renderer reproduce the same two base TEXT_COLLISION rows recorded in S378.
